questions.question_english: Parents complain that their children are no longer receiving out-of-100 marks and are instead given descriptive bands like 'Beginning', 'Progressing', and 'Proficient' alongside detailed feedback on skills. options_english: Competency assessment focuses on skill mastery rather than arbitrary ranking, promoting holistic growth.
The old marking system violated longstanding state government administrative guidelines and financial mandates regarding the collection of official examination fees.
The new descriptive evaluation model is legally mandatory and parents possess no administrative right to question internal school operational decisions.

questions.explanation_english: Formative evaluation emphasizes continuous monitoring during instruction to provide actionable feedback for learners and educators. Because its primary goal is developmental improvement rather than final grading or high-stakes certification, it carries low stakes for students. key_facts: Formative evaluation focuses on developmental improvement.

Printed answer key: (B) The old marking system violated longstanding state government administrative guidelines and financial mandates regarding the collection of official examination fees.
